texts:
In the early 1900's,
a dark shadow covered a small
country town in rural America.

The dark shadow formed
mysteriously at the
summit of Mt Itoi.

At that time,
numerous paranormal
incidents occured.

The last incident
involved the disappearance
of a young married couple.

The man's name was George.
The woman's name was Maria.

As soon as they disappeared,
so did the dark shadow.

Two years later,
as suddenly as he left,
George returned.

He never told anyone
where he had been
or what he had done.

But he began an odd
study of psychic powers,
all by himself.

As for Maria,
his wife...
She never returned.

80 years have passed
since then.
The year is 1988.
Outside Podunk, a small town in America.

20世纪初，一片诡异的阴影笼罩了
美国乡间的一座小镇。

这片诡影在糸井山的山巅上
神秘地凝聚成形。
那段时间，超自然事件接连不断。

最后一起事件
涉及到了一对年轻夫妇的离奇失踪。
丈夫名为乔治，妻子名为玛丽亚。

他们消失的那一刻，
那片诡影也随之散去。

两年后，一如当年消失时那样，
乔治突然回来了。

他从未向任何人透露自己去了哪里，
又做了什么。

但随后他却开始独自一人进行
对PSI的奇异研究。
至于他的妻子玛丽亚…
她再也没有回来。
时光飞逝，80年过去了。
时间来到了1988年。
故事发生于美国的一座小镇，波顿克郊外。
